messages:
Maria P: Quick sync — need to finalize priority slices for the prod rollout. Deliverables: SLAs, docs checklist, onboarding flow, runbooks. Target: EOD Friday. Who can own which pieces?

AJ: I'd split into three priority slices: 1) Core Hosted API (PLG customers) 2) Dedicated / reserved customers 3) Private / VPC / on‑prem pilots. Each slice gets SLOs, doc set, and support plan. Thoughts?

Dave S: +1. Concern: Private pilot needs on‑call overlap with infra team for first 2 weeks. Also capacity planning for dedicated pools — need traffic profile by customer.

Sophia L: Docs plan: one‑pager SLA summary + runbook + step‑by‑step onboarding guide with example curl/SDK snippets. I can own runbook + examples. Need the SLO table from product.

Maria P: Proposal draft SLOs (very rough):
```
availability: 99.9% monthly
p95 latency (text gen, small prompt): <=200ms
error rate: <0.1% per 1h window
```
Open to adjustments per slice.

AJ: For Dedicated, availability SLA should be 99.95 and include committed throughput. For Hosted we can tier: Free/Starter (best‑effort), Standard (99.9), Enterprise (99.95+). FinOps to define burst pricing and overage model.

DeployBot: FYI — prod deploy window closes in 2 hours for this sprint :rotating_light:

Rachel (Legal): For Private/VPC we need DPA/KMS callouts in docs + explicit data residency section. Contracts must reference SLA numbers and support SLAs. I can draft the legal blurb.

Maria P: Owner map: @Sophia L — runbook & onboarding guide; @AJ — SLA numbers & pricing tiers; @Dave S — oncall staffing/ops runbook; @Rachel (Legal) — contract/DPA text. Please ack and add ETA.

Sophia L: Ack. I'll push a skeleton to the docs repo Thursday 12:00 PST.

Dave S: Ack. I'll confirm oncall rota by Wed COB. Need headcount from product.

AJ: I'll loop FinOps and draft pricing tiers by Wed EOD.

Maria P: Quick question: do we want canary / fallback policies in the runbook or separate? I think include a simple canary checklist in the runbook and link to advanced fallback docs.

Sophia L: Include the canary checklist in runbook (short) and a link to the detailed rollback playbook.

Maria P: Great. I'll consolidate owners into the launch readiness doc and ping the group tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
